entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Oh, hello. I... I'm a bit lost. I think I need to return something? I have this helmet, and the website was just so confusing.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I please get your name and order number?
Yes, it's Alex Miller. The order number is... um, let me find it... it's VF88201.

Thank you, Alex. I see the order here for the Aero Road Helmet. I can definitely look into a return for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, I guess it's a preference? It was a gift. The color isn't quite what I expected, and I never got around to using it. The box is still here, completely box unopened. I just feel so overwhelmed with the whole process. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Alex. I'm here to make this easy for you. Let me just confirm the delivery date... It looks like the helmet was delivered 69 days ago.
Sixty-nine days? Oh no, is that too long? I had no idea, I'm so sorry.

Not at all. Let me just check our policy here... Okay, you're all good. For a standard item like this helmet, we have a 90-day return policy. Your safety is our top priority, and we want to ensure you have the right gear.
Really? Oh, that's such a relief. So I can send it back?

Absolutely. I've just processed the return approval in our system. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. All you need to do is print it, attach it to the original package, and drop it off at the post office.
Wow. That's... thank you so much, Charlie. You've made this so much easier for me.
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a great day, and ride safely with VeloFit.
